# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/bk
# args: 
Usage: bk <command> [flags]

Work with Buildkite from the command line.

Flags:
  -h, --help        Show context-sensitive help.
  -y, --yes         Skip all confirmation prompts
      --no-input    Disable all interactive prompts
  -q, --quiet       Suppress progress output
      --no-pager    Disable pager for text output
      --debug       Enable debug output for REST API calls

Commands:
  agent install [flags]
    Install the buildkite-agent binary locally.

  agent run [flags]
    Run an ephemeral buildkite-agent locally.

  agent pause <agent-id> [flags]
    Pause a Buildkite agent.

  agent list [flags]
    List agents.

  agent resume <agent-id>
    Resume a Buildkite agent.

  agent stop [<agents> ...] [flags]
    Stop Buildkite agents.

  agent view <agent> [flags]
    View details of an agent.

  api [<endpoint>] [flags]
    Interact with the Buildkite API

  artifacts download [<artifact-id>] [flags]
    Download artifacts from a build.

  artifacts list (ls) [<build-number>] [flags]
    List artifacts for a build or a job in a build.

  auth login [flags]
    Login to Buildkite using OAuth or an API token

  auth logout [flags]
    Logout and remove stored credentials

  auth status [flags]
    Print the current user auth status

  auth switch (use) [<organization-slug>]
    Switch to a different organization

  auth token
    Print the stored API token for the current organization

  browse [<build>] [flags]
    Open Buildkite resources in a web browser

  build create (new) [flags]
    Create a new build.

  build cancel <build-number> [flags]
    Cancel a build.

  build view [<build-number>] [flags]
    View build information.

  build list (ls) [flags]
    List builds.

  build download [<build-number>] [flags]
    Download resources for a build.

  build rebuild [<build-number>] [flags]
    Rebuild a build.

  build watch [<build-number>] [flags]
    Watch a build's progress in real-time.

  cluster list (ls) [flags]
    List clusters.

  cluster view <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    View cluster information.

  cluster create --name=STRING [flags]
    Create a new cluster.

  cluster update <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    Update a cluster.

  cluster delete (rm) <cluster-uuid>
    Delete a cluster.

  maintainer list (ls) <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    List cluster maintainers.

  maintainer create <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    Create a cluster maintainer.

  maintainer delete (rm) <cluster-uuid> <maintainer-id>
    Delete a cluster maintainer.

  queue list (ls) <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    List cluster queues.

  queue view <cluster-uuid> <queue-uuid> [flags]
    View a cluster queue.

  queue create --key=STRING <cluster-uuid> [flags]
    Create a new cluster queue.

  queue update <cluster-uuid> <queue-uuid> [flags]
    Update a cluster queue.

  queue delete (rm) <cluster-uuid> <queue-uuid>
    Delete a cluster queue.

  queue pause <cluster-uuid> <queue-uuid> [flags]
    Pause dispatch for a cluster queue.

  queue resume <cluster-uuid> <queue-uuid> [flags]
    Resume dispatch for a cluster queue.

  secret list (ls) --cluster-uuid=STRING [flags]
    List secrets for a cluster.

  secret get --cluster-uuid=STRING --secret-id=STRING [flags]
    View a cluster secret.

  secret create --cluster-uuid=STRING --key=STRING [flags]
    Create a new cluster secret.

  secret update --cluster-uuid=STRING --secret-id=STRING [flags]
    Update a cluster secret.

  secret delete (rm) --cluster-uuid=STRING --secret-id=STRING
    Delete a cluster secret.

  skill add <name> [flags]
    Install a Buildkite skill.

  skill update [<name>] [flags]
    Update an installed Buildkite skill.

  skill delete (rm) <name> [flags]
    Delete an installed Buildkite skill.

  team list (ls) [flags]
    List teams.

  team view <team-uuid> [flags]
    View team information.

  team create <name> [flags]
    Create a new team.

  team update <team-uuid> [flags]
    Update a team.

  team delete (rm) <team-uuid>
    Delete a team.

  config list (ls) [flags]
    List configuration values.

  config get <key>
    Get a configuration value.

  config set <key> <value> [flags]
    Set a configuration value.

  config unset <key> [flags]
    Remove a configuration value.

  init [flags]
    Initialize a pipeline.yaml file

  job cancel <job-id> [flags]
    Cancel a job.

  job list (ls) [flags]
    List jobs.

  job log <job-id> [flags]
    Get logs for a job.

  job reprioritize (priority) <job-id> <priority> [flags]
    Reprioritize a job.

  job retry <job-id> [flags]
    Retry a job.

  job ssh <job-uuid>
    Connect to a running hosted job over SSH.

  job unblock <job-id> [flags]
    Unblock a job.

  job vnc <job-uuid>
    Connect to a running hosted macOS job over VNC.

  organization (org) list (ls) [flags]
    List configured organizations.

  pipeline copy (cp) [<pipeline>] [flags]
    Copy an existing pipeline.

  pipeline create <name> [flags]
    Create a new pipeline.

  pipeline list (ls) [flags]
    List pipelines.

  pipeline convert (migrate) --file=STRING [flags]
    Convert a CI/CD pipeline configuration to Buildkite format.

  pipeline validate [flags]
    Validate a pipeline YAML file.

  pipeline view [<pipeline>] [flags]
    View a pipeline.

  package push <registry-slug> [<std-in-arg>] [flags]
    Push a new package to a Buildkite registry

  preflight run [flags]
    Run a build against a snapshot of the local working tree (experimental)

  preflight cleanup [flags]
    Clean up completed preflight branches (experimental)

  user invite <emails> ...
    Invite users to your organization.

  update [flags]
    Update the installed bk CLI or print update instructions

  version [flags]
    Print the version of the CLI being used

Run "bk <command> --help" for more information on a command.
